summary: IR-camera + Z-piezo PI feedback. Required for the FocusLock widget.

fields.label: Detector
fields.tip: Detector used for the focus-lock IR spot. The detector should have forFocusLock=true.

fields.label: Z Positioner
fields.tip: Z positioner used to apply focus corrections.

fields.label: Update freq (Hz)
fields.tip: Focus-estimate update rate in hertz: the camera is read and the correction computed this many times per second. Must be positive; rates above 1000 Hz are floored to a 1 ms timer.

fields.label: Crop X
fields.tip: Starting X position of camera frame crop.

fields.label: Crop Y
fields.tip: Starting Y position of camera frame crop.

fields.label: Swap image axes
fields.tip: Transpose the camera frame before locating the spot.

fields.label: PI Kp
fields.tip: Proportional gain of the feedback loop.

fields.label: PI Ki
fields.tip: Integral gain of the feedback loop.

fields.label: Positioner axis
fields.tip: Positioner axis used for focus-lock movements. Empty (null) uses "Z" if the configured positioner has it, otherwise axis 0.

fields.label: Settle allowance (s)
fields.tip: Settle allowance for the actuator after a scan released it, in seconds. The reacquisition deadline is this plus the time the sample window takes, samples / update rate. On timeout the lock is left off and a warning is logged. Raise it on rigs whose piezo takes longer to settle than the camera takes to deliver the samples.

fields.label: Return tolerance (px)
fields.tip: How close the focus signal must return to its pre-scan setpoint before the lock re-engages, in camera pixels. The default is a placeholder, not measured on hardware: the meaningful value depends on the rig's px-to-µm calibration (too loose re-engages against a defocused sample, too tight times out on every tile). Calibrate it before relying on 3D tiling.

fields.label: Settle samples
fields.tip: Number of consecutive focus estimates the reacquisition barrier averages before deciding the signal has settled. At least 2.
